project_type: Vite 5 + React 18 + TypeScript SPA (frontend at project root) + new Python FastAPI backend (backend/)
build_system: Vite 5 for frontend (vite.config.ts, alias '@' -> src/). Python backend has no build step — run with uvicorn. Root package.json is 'type': 'module'. No monorepo; backend/ lives alongside src/.
test_framework: No test runner configured. Manual verification via curl and browser smoke tests.
build_command: npm run build (Vite, frontend only). Backend: uvicorn backend.main:app --reload --port 8000
test_command: npm run typecheck (TypeScript only). No pytest suite.
verification_instructions: 1. pip install -r backend/requirements.txt. 2. python backend/seed_data.py — must print seeding messages and create backend/models/*.pkl. 3. uvicorn backend.main:app --reload --port 8000 — must print 'Application startup complete'. 4. curl http://localhost:8000/api/health returns {status:ok}. 5. curl http://localhost:8000/api/models returns JSON array of 4 objects with detection_accuracy > 0. 6. POST /api/prompts/predict with malicious text returns label=1. 7. POST /api/admin/reviews/r1/classify stores a row in DB and returns retrained=true. 8. npm run typecheck from project root must pass with 0 errors. 9. npm run dev starts Vite on :5173. 10. Browser: Training screen Model Training Status table shows live accuracy values. Admin Review: classifying a prompt does not throw console error.
snapshot_or_generated_files: backend/prismguard.db and backend/models/*.pkl are auto-generated by seed_data.py. Both must be in .gitignore and NOT committed.
environment_constraints: Windows 10/11, PowerShell. Python 3.11+ assumed. pip available globally or in virtualenv. uvicorn runs on port 8000 (matches PORT=8000 in .env). Vite dev server on :5173 (matches CORS_ORIGINS in .env). The .env at project root already has DATABASE_PATH=backend/prismguard.db and CORS_ORIGINS=http://localhost:5173.
contribution_requirements: No AGENTS.md found. README.md is nearly empty. No special commit email requirement discovered (the previous Node.js plan mentioned kanishjebamathew.m@gmail.com but that was from a different task).
key_patterns: Frontend screens use named exports (export function Training). Screens import from '@/data' using '@' alias mapped to src/ in vite.config.ts. Types are in src/types.ts — do NOT change existing interface shapes. src/api.ts (not src/lib/api.ts) is the new API client file. No existing api.ts, no existing backend/ directory, no existing server/ directory — all backend code is brand new. Screens that need modification: AdminReview.tsx (PromptReview.handleSubmit only) and Training.tsx (model stats table only). All other screens are unchanged.
